== Biography ==
Mary was born about 1837. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-2603|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Lamb-11245|Mary Lamb]]. She passed away in 1920.
== Research Notes ==
=== Current paternal evidence ===
The father relationship to [[Glasgow-2603]] is assessed at 94% (confident). Mary Maria Glasgow's baptism on 31 August 1836 at Manchester is indexed to Robert Glasgow and Mary Glasgow, and Robert [[Glasgow-2603]]'s will in the 1876-77 Wellington probate file names his daughter Mary Knox. A parent-naming baptism with her distinctive double forename and a will naming her by married name raise the father link from 82% to 94% proved.

Baptism index transcript only; register uninspected. The will names her as Mary Knox, identified with Mary Maria by the Turakina family account. No mother change follows.
<ref>[https://www.bdmhistoricalrecords.dia.govt.nz/search/search?path=%2FqueryEntry.m%3Ftype%3Dmarriages NZ marriage registration 1859/2668 (https://www.bdmhistoricalrecords.dia.govt.nz/search/search?path=%2FqueryEntry.m%3Ftype%3Dmarriages)].</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9841/records/34597737 England, Select Births and Christenings, 1538-1975 — Mary Maria Glasgow, 31 Aug 1836, Manchester, Lancashire, England].</ref><ref>[https://www.bdmhistoricalrecords.dia.govt.nz/search/search?path=%2FqueryEntry.m%3Ftype%3Dmarriages NZ marriage registration 1866/6424 (https://www.bdmhistoricalrecords.dia.govt.nz/search/search?path=%2FqueryEntry.m%3Ftype%3Dmarriages) married Mary Stewart].</ref>

The dated reviews below describe earlier stages of this research.


=== Earlier father review, 22 October 2026 ===

In this earlier review, the father [[Glasgow-2603]] is assessed at 82% (probable). The held account assigns Mary Maria (Glasgow) Knox to Robert Glasgow and Mary Lamb in the Bombay/Turakina family. Mary Maria’s 1837 Manchester birth and Turakina family placement fit, without a held direct parent field.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Earlier proposed test: Inspect the 1842 Bombay passenger family list and the child’s NZ death certificate parent fields.

Source basis already held: [https://www.bdmhistoricalrecords.dia.govt.nz/search/search?path=%2FqueryEntry.m%3Ftype%3Dmarriages NZ marriage registration 1859/2668 (https://www.bdmhistoricalrecords.dia.govt.nz/search/search?path=%2FqueryEntry.m%3Ftype%3Dmarriages)].
